title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP programme will be implemented in four counties (Busia, Homabay, Kisumu and Migori) and will support 8,000 households and 48,000 beneficiaries. The aim of the programme is to establish an efficient and well-functioning seed system and markets for disease free and drought resistant cassava. Within each county the programme will work with one SME, 5 Seed Entrepreneurs, 2,000 farmers and 3 Processing Units. Each SME will work with 5 Seed Entrepreneurs who in turn will supply 2,000 farmers over the 5-year programme. Drought resistant cassava varieties will be propagated in a KALRO lab and planted in selected SME farms and KALRO stations. Indirectly, this project will support 12,000 farmers (3,000 by county) to access seeds and markets through strengthening the business capacity of the Seed Entrepreneurs and Processing Units to reach farmers, who are in the SHA cassava networks.The programme will build the capacity of seed entrepreneurs and deliver training for small holder farmers on good agricultural practices for improved cassava varieties, intercropping, pests and disease management. Cassava tubers produced by farmers will be supplied to the Processing Units (PUs), where they will be processed into Cassava chips. Equipment for cassava processing will be provided to the PUs and they will be trained in basic processing techniques, quality standards, business and financial management. Engagement workshops and Cassava Trade Fairs will also be organised to facilitate links between Processing Units, Seed Entrepreneurs and farmers and links created with financial service providers.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 5: Strengthening governance for effective institutions to deliver inclusive and equitable sustainable landscape management and sustainable food systems which support transitions to an adaptive green economy. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The project in Kenya which supports stakeholder and policy engagement relating to food systems, landscapes and sustainable businesss.
